questions.question: Agriculture's direct share of South Africa's GDP is roughly:
The linkages lever argues agriculture matters because it:
options: Supplies the raw materials of agro-processing — mills, canneries, cellars, abattoirs

questions.question: Which product belongs primarily on South Africa's EXPORT list?
Agriculture slows rural depopulation because it:
options: Anchors settlement and provides jobs where little other work exists

subtopics.title: Two Farming Worlds: Small-Scale and Large-Scale

questions.question: Which feature marks LARGE-SCALE commercial farming?
options: Family labour on a communal plot
Deep capital — tractors, irrigation, scientific inputs — and production for market and export
No access to insurance or finance

questions.question: Communal tenure blocks small farmers from bank credit because:
options: Communal farmers earn too much to qualify
Communal land cannot easily stand as collateral for a loan

questions.question: The five clean comparison lines between the two systems are:
options: Farm size, capital and technology, labour source, market orientation, land tenure

questions.question: A balanced evaluation concedes that large-scale farming feeds the nation and exports BUT:
options: Employs fewer people per hectare as it mechanises

subtopics.title: The Maize Case Study: From Highveld Field to Export Terminal

questions.question: The Maize Triangle sweeps across:
options: Western Cape, Northern Cape, Eastern Cape
The Free State, North West and the Mpumalanga highveld
The Karoo and the West Coast

questions.question: A physical factor FAVOURING maize on the plateau is:
options: Summer rain of roughly 500–800 mm arriving in the growing season

questions.question: Maize "feeds the country twice" because:
options: It is harvested twice a year
It is eaten at lunch and supper
White maize is the human staple and yellow maize the base of animal feed

questions.question: The chief hindering factor for maize production is:
options: Rainfall variability and recurring drought in the summer-rainfall interior

subtopics.title: Food Security: The Framework, the Factors, the Fixes

questions.question: "Physical AND economic access" in the definition means food must be:
options: Nearby AND affordable — either failure alone breaks security

questions.question: South Africa's food security paradox is:
options: National-level security while millions of households are food insecure

questions.question: Which trio lists ECONOMIC factors influencing food security?
options: Unemployment, food price inflation, input costs

questions.question: The National School Nutrition Programme is best described as:
options: An access-side intervention feeding around nine million learners

subtopics.title: The Country That Runs on Pap

questions.question: Maize is on the supper plate "at least twice" because it appears:
options: As visible pap and hidden in the chicken and egg raised on maize feed
As both a starch and a vegetable

questions.question: The tall silos along the grain-belt railways represent:
options: The support infrastructure a national-scale harvest requires

questions.question: "A thunderstorm keeps its own diary" captures the risk that:
options: Summer rain sometimes fails entirely, leaving the whole triangle in drought

questions.question: Drought-year maize price rises strike the poorest homes first because:
options: Pap is the staple food of tight budgets

questions.question: On the five-finger comparison, "title-deed ownership against communal rights" is the line for:
The fair verdict on the small farm is that it:
options: Sustains millions of families but low yields leave each household exposed

questions.question: "A bridge over the fence, not a winner" describes policy that:
options: Helps small farmers grow toward commercial production with finance, tenure, training and markets

questions.question: Secure land rights unlock growth for small farmers because:
options: The plot itself can then stand behind a loan
They remove the need for rain

questions.question: The riddle "full silos, empty plates" resolves because:
options: National supply is adequate but poverty blocks household access
The country grows too little maize

questions.question: A family standing before stocked shelves with an empty purse is:
options: Food insecure — economic access has failed
Food secure because the food is nearby

questions.question: The three bags of food security causes are:
options: The nature bag, the money bag and the people bag

questions.question: Which fix is correctly matched to its bag?
options: School feeding — aimed at the nature bag
Drought-tolerant seed — aimed at the money bag
Drought-tolerant cultivars — aimed at the nature bag
